title: Venuti, Sudhalter and the Williams College Whiteman library
summary: Others copied his Whiteman arrangements from Williams College and performed them in England without paying him.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Venuti. He had traveled all over Europe and he told me that he could get anything he wanted over there in the way of musicians and Sudhalter even wanted me to go to England and do it. 'You could get good musicians over there' and he did some concerts over there and called me up from England and wanted me to come over there, but he didn't want to pay enough. Didn't want to pay the expense.
I don't know how he made out, he must have made out all right. He went up to Williams, and got all the material out of Williams College. He copied it off and took it over there and gave concerts.
What was it doing at Williams College?
That's where the Whiteman collection is.

All the arrangements, from the 30's Fende's and all Lenny's and Roy's, the whole works, the whole Whiteman library is up in Williams College and I have been up there and it's a -- it's nice. They got a cue, cross-cue, it's beautifully done, and well, what's his name, went up there and copied it all off, had them xeroxed and took them over to England and gave concerts, and they were mostly my arrangements, so --
You didn't get anything from it.
I didn't get anything from it.
